title: Hold the qualifications required to practise as a land valuer
what: Carry on business, or hold out, as a land valuer only after completing an accredited course and gaining the required practical experience.

sources.title: Land Valuers Act 2001 (Tas)
sources.quote: A natural person must not carry on business, or hold himself or herself out, as a land valuer unless he or she has satisfactorily completed an accredited course and has the required practical experience
